Mature Suburban & Historic Tree Canopies · Mount Laurel, NJ

Why Mount Laurel Homes Face Unique Gutter Challenges

Mount Laurel is defined by its mature tree canopy — the century-old oaks, silver maples, and sycamores that line every street in Burlington County. That canopy is beautiful, but it drops an enormous volume of leaves, samaras (maple helicopters), and seed pods onto the roofline three seasons a year.

Un-guarded gutters in Mount Laurel, NJ fill in a single storm. Once water overflows the trough, it runs behind the fascia and down the exterior wall — the exact failure mode that rots rafter tails, stains brick, and floods finished basements. Homes with slate or cedar detailing lose even more when a low-quality guard is bolted onto the shingle.

Our fix is a high-flow LeafBlaster Pro micro-mesh system, mounted low-profile so it disappears behind the drip edge on historic Mount Laurel homes. The mesh moves 100+ inches of hourly rainfall while the marine-grade stainless keeps every oak leaf, samara, and pine tassel out of the trough for the life of the roof.

Gutter Guards FAQ

Everything Mount Laurel homeowners ask us

How much do gutter guards cost in Mount Laurel, NJ?

Most single-story homes in Mount Laurel run $8–$14 per linear foot installed. Two-story homes with high pitches and complex rooflines range from $14–$22 per foot. We give a firm written quote on site, in writing, before any work starts.

Do LeafBlaster Pro guards really stop pine needles?

Yes. The 50-micron stainless-steel mesh is finer than a pine needle, so needles slide off the sloped surface instead of embedding. This is the #1 reason homeowners in the Pine Barrens choose LeafBlaster Pro over screen guards.

Will gutter guards work with my existing gutters?

In most cases, yes. We inspect your existing 5-inch or 6-inch aluminum gutters, resecure them, replace failing sections, and install the mesh on top. If gutters are undersized or damaged beyond repair, we quote seamless replacement in the same visit.

Is there a warranty?

LeafBlaster Pro carries a lifetime transferable no-clog performance warranty, and we back our install with a lifetime workmanship warranty. If it ever clogs on us, we come back and fix it — free.

How long does installation take in Mount Laurel?

Most Mount Laurel homes are completed in a single day. We arrive between 7:30 and 8:30 AM, take care of cleanout, install the guards, water-test everything, and clean the property before we leave.

Are you licensed and insured in NJ?

Yes. We carry full general liability insurance, workers' comp, and required NJ home-improvement contractor registration. We provide certificates on request before any deposit is taken.

Why do standard gutter screens fail against Mount Laurel's tree canopy?

Massive volume clogs cause water to overflow behind the fascia, rotting rafter tails, staining brick, and flooding basements at the drip line. In Mount Laurel, NJ, that is exactly why we install LeafBlaster Pro 316 stainless micro-mesh instead of a slotted screen or foam insert.

How do freeze-thaw cycles and winter weather in Burlington County affect micro-mesh guards?

Burlington County sees repeated freeze-thaw cycles from December through March. Rigid 316 stainless micro-mesh, mounted on a powder-coated aluminum sub-frame, does not warp, sag, or crack under ice load — the reason we install LeafBlaster Pro exclusively on Mount Laurel homes rather than pop-in plastic or foam inserts.
